skills.description: 把**手机（USB 直连 iPhone）或电脑**上的实况/视频/照片拼成一条成片：保真拼接（时间序零转场）、编排短片（掐段/重排叙事/交叉淡化）、BPM 卡点（每段锁整数拍、剪辑点落拍）、ACE-Step 本地生成配乐并精确对齐拍点、片头封面页（防黑缩略图）、静态照片按秒停留带推镜。触发场景：「手机已经连电脑了」「从手机里找今天拍的照片/实况」「实况拼成长视频」「这些片段合成一条」「帮我剪得更有冲击力」「视频里放的照片也停几秒」「把照片也剪进去」「配个音乐」「生成一段音乐」「我自己加音乐」「音乐我来配」「不用你配乐」「按节奏剪」「卡点」「踩点」「音乐没贯彻全片」「后面没音乐了」「音乐太单调」「只有一个调子」「加个封面」「片头封面」「封面页」「黑不溜秋的」「首帧是黑的」「缩略图是黑的」。⚠️ 铁律：① 取材只用纯 Python 的 pymobiledevice3 直读 /DCIM，绝不走 Homebrew（本机 brew 在沙箱内必败）；② 判朝向必须用**真实显示尺寸**（算入旋转矩阵），用编码尺寸会把竖屏全判成横屏；③ **出片前先问发哪个平台，默认横竖两版都出、都保留**；④ **配乐前先问「音乐您自己加，还是我帮您加」**——自己加就只出无配乐母版并推荐剪映等第三方工具；⑤ 音乐对齐只能由剪辑侧做（先锁 BPM 再配乐），生成模型不保证节拍；⑥ 封面亮度是硬指标（YAVG ≥ 110），`fade_in=0` 必须整条 fade 滤镜不加。核心工具：`concat_clips`（保真拼接）/ `impact_edit`（编排+卡点渲染）/ `beat_plan`（锁拍片单）/ `make_cover`（封面）/ `pick_cue`+`mix_cue`（配乐对齐混音）。

skills.description: Orchestration entry point that turns one or several Word documents (.docx) into finished gua LaTeX documents in a single run: extract body images, stage them into the working directory fig/, read the docx text directly from OOXML, recover ALL formulas (Word-native OMML / MathType OLE / image-encoded) via a strict source cascade — same-name PDF first, else ask the user for one manual Save-As, else render the docx-embedded formula metafiles to PNG and transcribe visually — then build a verified figure-to-problem mapping, hand off to the gua template skill for typesetting, xelatex compile and clean up, and finally run a source-level / render-level / PDF-level acceptance checklist. Triggers include "把这份 word 整理成学案", "word 转 gua 学案", "docx 一条龙整理", "提取图片并整理成学案", "把 word 的图片和正文一起排版", "word2tex 全流程", or whenever the user supplies a .docx together with a request to produce a gua 学案/试卷/周测卷/练习卷 and does not want to run the atomic skills by hand. Use it INSTEAD of manually invoking docx-image-extractor and gua-learningplan-organizer in sequence. It is a thin SOP layer: it owns only the seams (figure staging, source-of-truth choice, formula recovery cascade, figure-to-problem mapping, per-type figure alignment) and delegates all template conventions to the atomic skills. STRUCTURE — READ THIS FILE FIRST: it is the main SOP and holds only the decisions, the command lines and the pre-delivery acceptance checklist. The deep technique catalogs (formula-recovery cascade, the figure-to-problem mapping toolbox 5a/5a′/5a-补1-16, typesetting policy, rework procedure) and their empirical case notes live in references/*.md and are read ON DEMAND — every step in the main SOP states exactly when to open which reference, so do NOT read the references up front.
